newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $16.04 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $16.04 million in T-bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold 344 million rupees ($16.04 million) worth of T-bills at its weekly auction from 700 million rupees tendered, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 141.0 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 8.19 percent on Thursday, against 247.0 million rupees at 7.98 percent last week.
The bank sold 182-day bills worth 94.0 million rupees with an average yield of 8.31 percent, against 306.2 million rupees at 8.14 percent last week.
The bank sold 364-day bills worth 109.0 million rupees at an average yield of 8.46 percent, against 117.0 million rupees at 8.08 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 8.31 percent per annum from 8.07 percent last week, the bank said.
